verdict.rationale: Numeral does not document a first-party tax AI assistant. Its official MCP server lets an external, bring-your-own agent (Claude, Cursor, etc.) query account data such as nexus position, filings, transactions, products and exemption certificates, and answer questions grounded in that data. That covers only a sliver of the story, and it relies on a generic LLM client rather than Numeral's own AI. Missing for 10: a native first-party AI assistant, product-taxability-by-state answers from Numeral's rule base, explanations of why a specific invoice was taxed a certain way, citations to tax rules or statutes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
